title: Normalized automorphism pullback square and ordinary exchange at field coefficients
statement:
Fix primes $p\ne\ell$, $a\ge1$, $q=p^a$, $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, an algebraic closure $k$ of $k_0$, a finite $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside an algebraic closure $\Omega$, and $\Lambda\in\{E,\Omega\}$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $X,Y$ be finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ a separated finite-type $k$-morphism. Let $g_X:X\xrightarrow{\sim}X$ and $g_Y:Y\xrightarrow{\sim}Y$ be automorphisms of schemes, not necessarily over $k$, satisfying $fg_X=g_Yf$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use the prescribed completed, raw rational and common-stage operations of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-weil-derived-direct-image]. All functors and composites are restricted to domains on which they preserve bounded constructibility; the field-stage comparisons and ordinary adjunctions have the supplied normalization of [def-exchange-projection]. Put $P_W=Lg_W^*$ for $W=X,Y$.

There is a natural isomorphism
$$a:P_XLf^*\xrightarrow{\sim}Lf^*P_Y.$$
Its integral component is precisely
$$a^{\mathcal O_E}_K=c^{\mathcal O_E}_{f,g_Y}(K)\circ(c^{\mathcal O_E}_{g_X,f}(K))^{-1},$$
through $L(fg_X)^*=L(g_Yf)^*$, where $c_{h,k}:L(kh)^*\simeq Lh^*Lk^*$ is the integral composition comparison of [lem-pod-integral-pullback-composition]. Its finite reductions are the corresponding composition square maps of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition]. No identification of integral comparisons merely from their separately evaluated reductions is part of the assertion.

At $E$ the comparison is the rationalized integral component, natural for every sum of pure tensors in a localized Hom group. At $\Omega$ its component on $(E,K)$ is the class of this rationalized component. These classes are natural also for arrows over larger common finite fields, independent of representatives and compatible with towers. More precisely, for $E\subset L$, let $\alpha^f,\alpha^{g_X},\alpha^{g_Y}$ be the canonical pullback scalar comparisons of [lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension, lem-pod-pullback-identities-scalar-extension]. With $T_W$ denoting integral scalar extension [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension], put
$$A_K=P_{g_X,L}(\alpha^f_K)\circ\alpha^{g_X}_{Lf_E^*K},\qquad B_K=Lf_L^*(\alpha^{g_Y}_K)\circ\alpha^f_{P_{g_Y,E}K}.$$
Then the specified components obey
$$B_K\circ T_X(a^{\mathcal O_E}_K)=a^{\mathcal O_L}_{T_YK}\circ A_K.$$
These are the comparisons conjugating the action of the two composite common-stage functors on arrows.

For the ordinary adjunction $Lf^*\dashv Rf_*$ [fix-prop-adjunctions](1), the unit--comparison--counit mate of $a^{-1}:Lf^*P_Y\simeq P_XLf^*$ is the specified exchange
$$\operatorname{Ex}_{*,K}=Rf_*P_X(\varepsilon_{f,K})\circ Rf_*((a^{-1})_{Rf_*K})\circ\eta_{f,P_YRf_*K}:P_YRf_*K\longrightarrow Rf_*P_XK$$
of [def-exchange-projection], and it is a natural isomorphism at both field stages. The horizontal transport functors are exact equivalences, with inverse pullbacks, as in [lem-pod-isomorphism-field-transport]; in particular no separatedness of $X,Y$ over $k$ is required. The assertion concerns these specified comparisons of the underlying operations, without any Weil structure on the inputs.
